subheading: CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE OTITIS MEDIA
subheading_corrected: CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE OTITIS MEDIA
text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF ACUTE OTITIS MEDIA
- Earache
- Fever
- Deafness
- Ear discharge
- Malaise (in babies, irritability)
- Redness of the eardrum
- Later, perforation and pulsating mucopurulent discharge
